experiment: DSE-011 compositional overlap and context-budget frontier
status: independent NumPy research pilot; not Rust qualification or production result
notes: The full 168-row per-method CSV is in the reproducibility bundle; the repository tracks the compact aggregate summary.
The 100% Hit@1 cells are synthetic easy cases with distinguishing cues and are not a production quality estimate.
When every query cue is shared across an eight-record group, identity is not identifiable from those cues; a correct policy should request more context or abstain.
The component scorer stores/visits fact-level data and must be compared on a memory/latency frontier; it is not a free upgrade.
